sources.entry: Itsyconnect - App Store Connect client for metadata, TestFlight, reviews, analytics, and localization. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/nickustinov/itsyconnect-macos)

summary.one_liner: A free, MIT-licensed desktop app and self-hosted web dashboard that offers an alternative front end to Apple's App Store Connect for managing app metadata, TestFlight, analytics, and customer reviews.
summary.what_it_does: Itsyconnect lets you edit App Store listing text (descriptions, keywords, what's new, promotional text, names, subtitles) across all locales at once, and choose build, release method, and phased rollout. It manages TestFlight builds, beta groups, and testers, with per-build installs, sessions, crashes, and tester feedback. It shows analytics such as impressions, downloads, proceeds, and conversion funnel, and tracks keyword character budgets and duplicates per locale. It also handles customer review filtering, translation, and reply drafting, screenshot upload and reordering, and App Store nominations. The README describes AI features that use your own API key from several providers, and an optional diff mode that stages changes locally before pushing them to App Store Connect. Data is stored in a local SQLite file, with credentials encrypted using AES-256-GCM and the master key kept in the macOS Keychain.
use_cases: edit App Store listing text in every locale at once
manage TestFlight builds, groups, and testers
review app analytics and crash reports
reply to customer App Store reviews
translate app metadata and screenshots with AI
run a self-hosted App Store Connect dashboard in Docker
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README's clone URL is blank; use https://github.com/nickustinov/itsyconnect-macos)
notable: Local-first: one SQLite database, no cloud, accounts, or telemetry
Diff mode stages metadata changes and pushes them to App Store Connect in one batch
MCP server lets AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode manage listings
Screenshot translation via Gemini 3 Pro Image while preserving layout
Self-hosted Docker option with reverse proxy guidance for Caddy, Nginx, and Tailscale
caveats: The Docker container has no built-in authentication and needs a reverse proxy if exposed beyond the local machine
Desktop builds are distributed as a direct DMG download, and the README requires macOS 11 or later
AI features require your own API key from a supported provider
keywords: free alternative to app store connect
